company.name: Formlabs
company.shortDescription: Formlabs develops and manufactures 3D printers and software for the industrial sector.
company.description:
Formlabs is developing an affordable high-resolution 3D printer to enable designers, engineers, and makers to realize their dreams in beautiful physical form easily. It manufactures 3D printing systems for various industries such as education, dentistry, health care, jewelry, and research.

Formlabs is the preferred professional 3D printer for engineers, designers, manufacturers, and decision-makers worldwide. Their product lineup includes the Form 3, Form 3B, and Form 3L, all powered by Low Force Stereolithography (LFS)™ technology, and the Form 2 SLA 3D printer. They also offer Form Wash and Form Cure post-processing solutions, the Fuse 1 SLS 3D printer, and the Form Cell manufacturing solution. Formlabs develops its high-performance materials, continuously pushing the boundaries of 3D printing, and provides  3D printing software.

aiResearchSummary.text: Formlabs is researching and developing methods and systems for film tensioning in additive fabrication devices, washing apparatus and methods for processing 3D printed parts, techniques for casting from additively fabricated molds, and improved additive fabrication devices utilizing LCD and LED light sources. Additional areas include process optimization, support structure generation, post-processing automation, and material formulations. These efforts span hardware, process, and material innovations in 3D printing.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series E round raised $150,000,000, or 59.12% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,681,813 to $2,000,000,000, a 206.57x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
